fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: Sepolia Glamsterdam upgrade tomorrow at 13:13 UTC

client_updates.highlight: Shadow Fork round 1: Nethermind (fixed in 2.1), Besu (peering/empty blocks), ethrex (P2P) all had issues; round 2 went smoothly
focil-devnet-0 accidentally taken down; reconstruction failed due to insufficient supernodes (only 100 validators/node); will ensure supernode coverage going forward
Prysm releasing v7.2.1 for Sepolia: fixes builder proposer-settings bug, enables partial data columns by default, includes 200M gas limit
Teku 96.9.1 does not include 200M gas limit in release; teams running on develop branch to get it

el_breakout_eth_call_gas_limit.highlight: Geth bug: ETH call incorrectly caps gas at 16M transaction limit; fix covers eth_call, trace_call, eth_simulate — should be reflected in execution-apis spec
Consensus: fix belongs in execution-apis repo, not the EIP itself

action_items.action: Update execution-apis spec to document correct eth_call gas limit behavior (no 16M tx cap)
EIP authors: open PRs to move Glamsterdam EIPs to Last Call status before next EIP Editing Office Hour

decisions.decision: Builders will not be onboarded pre-fork on Sepolia; Hoodi recommended for pre-fork builder testing
ETH call gas limit fix to be tracked in execution-apis repo, not the EIP
